@router.post("/api/v1/webhooks/github")
async def github_webhook_receiver(
    request: Request,
    org_slug: str = Query(...),
    x_hub_signature_256: str = Header(..., alias="X-Hub-Signature-256"),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_db)
):
    body = await request.body()
    expected_signature = "sha256=" + hmac.new(
        settings.GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET.encode(), body, hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(expected_signature, x_hub_signature_256):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="HMAC signature mismatch")

    event = json.loads(body.decode())
    installation_id = event.get("installation", {}).get("id")
    repo_id = event["repository"]["id"]
    repo_name = event["repository"]["full_name"]

    org_stmt = select(Organization).where(
        Organization.slug == org_slug,
        Organization.github_installation_id == installation_id
    )
    res = await db.execute(org_stmt)
    org = res.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not org:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="GitHub App installation not authorized for organization")

    binding = RepoSyncBinding(
        org_slug=org_slug,
        github_repo_id=repo_id,
        repo_full_name=repo_name,
        auto_sync=True
    )
    db.add(binding)
    await db.commit()
    return {"status": "bound"}
